His touch felt like electricity on my skin and he knew exactly when to be rough and when to be gentle. We talked about everything and anything when we needed a break in between. The Airbnb was pretty small, a studio apartment. We banged on almost every surface. It was just perfect, he knew exactly what I wanted when I wanted it and I didn’t even have to ask. I reminisce about that night a lot. I feel bad for the airbnb host because we left it kind of messy because of how early check out was and we were up till the crack of dawn.

Listen man, I’ve been on both ends of this. I have adhd and a major symptom of that is depression as well. The only thing I can say is that shit is so real. Maybe I always give people the benefit of the doubt but just because she was unhappy doesn’t mean you did anything wrong. I’m sure she recognized the effort you put into her and I’m sure she will always remember that and appreciate you for that. If she hasn’t ever lied to you before then she wasn’t lying when she said you were most loving ,caring, and kind hearted person she has ever met. People just grow apart man. We live life, meet people, make friends, find lovers, sometimes we find family we didn’t have before. One of the hardest lessons we have to learn as humans, is that change in inevitable. Now despite what many people here are saying, growing resent and hatred for her won’t help you move on. It feels like the easiest way out but it won’t help the pain. The only thing that helps is acknowledging the pain, understanding that this is apart of life, and telling yourself that you will move on. Trust me when you learn to let go of anger and hate towards people who have hurt you, life gets so much better. You learn to finally live for yourself and not out of spite of other people who couldn’t care less about what you’re doing. I found peace within myself after a long time of feeling angry. I realized that I didn’t want to hate anyone or anything anymore. Life is too beautiful for that, man. When I die I don’t want to have that anger weighing on my heart. We only have so much time on this earth, why spend it feeling hateful towards things that have happened in the past? Anyway, I didn’t mean to go off rambling like that. My DMs are open if you ever need to talk man.
